chapter: Clubs, readers and musicians he knew
title: Asking about McCurdy, Lexis, Harrison Barnes and Red Allen
summary: Allen asks whether he knew and played with Charles McCurdy, Ricard Alexis, Harrison Barnes and the Allens.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. Let me ask you a couple of names, see if you remember his father. Do you remember Charles McCurdy? Charles McCurdy, yeah. He used to be with Roeby Show's orchestra. Uh huh. He played with you too?
He wasn't, he wasn't a steady member.

Well, Riccardo-Lexis, him and I was pretty good friends, and we played together in places, you know, uh, on Exceptional's, you know, if we had an exception we might play together. And then we played the street together too. I see. Yeah. What about Harrison Barnes?
Yeah, uh huh. He was a block in one of the old bands, Enola.
Uh huh. He was a trombone player there. Yeah. I know him real good too. In the Enola band. Yeah. Uh huh. What about Red Allen? Allen? Not the old man Allen. Well, no,
We used to call him Red Allen, the young fella.
I never did play with him, but I knew him real well. And I knew his father too, see. I played several times with his father in the brass band. He had a brass band. That's right. Uh huh.
Let me see. What about Mercedes Fields? Who? Mercedes Fields? Fills?
